title: Medical Model Configuration Schema
description: This schema defines the structure for configuring medical model pipelines, including data preprocessing, feature generation, and prediction. It is used for validation and to provide autocompletion in compatible editors.

model_json_version.description: Version of the model JSON schema.

serialize_learning_set.description: If '1' or 'true', the training samples (learning set) will be serialized and stored within the model file. This is useful for debugging and reproducibility, but increases file size.

generate_masks_for_features.description: If '1' or 'true', a binary mask will be generated for features with missing values before any imputation is performed. This allows the model to potentially learn from the pattern of missingness.

max_data_in_mem.description: Maximum size of data (in terms of array elements, i.e., features * rows) to hold in memory at once. If the dataset exceeds this limit, it will be processed in batches. A value of 0 means no limit.

take_mean_pred.description: For models that produce multiple predictions (e.g., ensembles), this setting determines if the mean of the predictions should be taken. '1' for true, '0' for false.

model_actions.description: An array of components that define the model's pipeline. Actions are executed in the order they appear.

predictor.description: The machine learning algorithm to be used for prediction.

predictor_params.description: A string of key-value pairs (e.g., 'param1=value1,param2=value2') that will be passed to the predictor for configuration.

type.description: The type of statistic to calculate.

win_from.description: Start of the time window in 'time_unit' before the prediction time.

win_to.description: End of the time window in 'time_unit' before the prediction time.

d_win_from.description: Start of the second time window for 'win_delta' type.

d_win_to.description: End of the second time window for 'win_delta' type.

time_channel.description: Time channel of the signal to use.

val_channel.description: Value channel of the signal to use.

sum_channel.description: Value channel to use for summation in 'category_set_sum'.

sets.description: Comma-separated list of category names for 'category_set' types.

in_set_name.description: A name for the set to be used in the feature name.

bound_outcomeTime.description: If true, the window is bounded by the outcome time.

time_range_signal.description: A signal that defines a dynamic time range.

min_value.description: Minimum value for a signal to be considered.

max_value.description: Maximum value for a signal to be considered.

zero_missing.description: If true, missing values will be replaced by 'zero_missing_val'.

zero_missing_val.description: The value to use when 'zero_missing' is true.

missing_value.description: The value that represents a missing observation.

full_name.description: If true, forces the inclusion of channel numbers in the feature name.

rename_signal.description: A new name for the signal part of the feature name.

fg_basic.title: FG: Basic Statistics
fg_basic.description: Generates features based on simple statistics (e.g., last, avg, max) of a signal's values within a specified time window.

signal.description: The signal containing birth date/year information (e.g., 'BDATE', 'BYEAR').

fg_age.title: FG: Age
fg_age.description: Calculates the age of the patient at the time of each sample.

fg_gender.title: FG: Gender
fg_gender.description: Extracts the gender of the patient. Requires the 'GENDER' signal.

sets.description: If specified, creates a binary feature indicating if the signal's value is in this comma-separated set of categories.

in_set_name.description: A name for the set to be used in the feature name.

fg_singleton.title: FG: Singleton
fg_singleton.description: Generates a feature from a singleton signal (a signal with a single, timeless value per patient).

signal.description: The signal to apply the binned linear model to.

min_period.description: Minimum time period for a bin to be considered valid.

max_period.description: Maximum time period for a bin to be considered valid.

rfactor.description: Regularization factor, decrease in learning rate in each cycle.

sampling_strategy.description: The sampling strategy to use within each bin.

time_unit_periods.description: Time unit for min_period and max_period (e.g., 'days', 'hours').

time_channel.description: The channel index for the timestamp in the signal.

val_channel.description: The channel index for the value in the signal.

fg_binnedLm.title: FG: Binned Linear Model
fg_binnedLm.description: Generates features by applying a series of binned linear models.

fg_binnedLM.title: FG: Binned Linear Model (Alias)
fg_binnedLM.description: Generates features by applying a series of binned linear models.

smoking_features.description: Comma-separated list of smoking sub-features to generate.

fg_unified_smoking.title: FG: Unified Smoking
fg_unified_smoking.description: A unified generator for various smoking-related features.

fg_alcohol_properties.description: Specific properties for the 'alcohol' generator are not detailed in the provided code.

fg_alcohol.title: FG: Alcohol
fg_alcohol.description: Generates features related to alcohol consumption.

type.description: The type of feature to generate from the time-range signal.

win_from.description: Start of the time window in 'win_time_unit' before the prediction time.

win_to.description: End of the time window in 'win_time_unit' before the prediction time.

val_channel.description: Value channel of the signal to use.

sets.description: Comma-separated list of categories for 'ever', 'time_diff', etc.

check_first.description: For 'time_diff', if true, check from the first occurrence, otherwise from the last.

time_range_signal.description: A signal that defines a dynamic time range.

recurrence_delta.description: Time delta for defining a recurrence.

min_range_time.description: Minimum duration for a range to be considered.

zero_missing.description: If true, missing values will be replaced by 0.

strict_times.description: If true, the time range must be strictly within the window.

conditional_channel.description: A channel to use for conditional calculations.

first_evidence_time_channel.description: The channel containing the first evidence time.

regex_on_sets.description: If true, the 'sets' property will be treated as a regex.

fg_range.title: FG: Range
fg_range.description: Generates features from signals that represent a time range with a value (e.g., medication intake).

fg_drug_intake_properties.description: Specific properties for the 'drugIntake' generator are not detailed in the provided code.

fg_drugIntake.title: FG: Drug Intake
fg_drugIntake.description: Generates features related to drug intake coverage over time.

model_file.description: Path to a serialized model file to be used for generating features.

model_json.description: Path to a model JSON to train a sub-model.

model_train_samples.description: Path to samples for training the sub-model.

ensure_patient_ids.description: If true, ensures that patient IDs are consistent between the main model and the sub-model.

impute_existing_feature.description: If true, use the model to impute an existing feature instead of creating a new one.

use_overriden_predictions.description: If true, allows the sub-model's predictions to be overridden.

fg_model.title: FG: Model
fg_model.description: Uses a pre-trained model to generate features from its predictions.

time_bins.description: Defines binning for the extracted time unit.

fg_time.title: FG: Time
fg_time.description: Generates features from the timestamp of the samples themselves (e.g., month, day of week, hour).

attribute.description: The name of the sample attribute to use as a feature.

ftr_name.description: An optional new name for the generated feature.

fg_attribute.title: FG: Attribute
fg_attribute.description: Creates a feature directly from a sample attribute.

min_age.description: Minimum age for a patient to be included.

max_age.description: Maximum age for a patient to be included.

min_code_cnt.description: Minimum count for a category to be considered.

fdr.description: False Discovery Rate for statistical tests.

lift_below.description: Filter features with lift below this value.

lift_above.description: Filter features with lift above this value.

filter_child_pval_diff.description: P-value difference threshold for filtering child categories.

filter_child_lift_ratio.description: Lift ratio threshold for filtering child categories.

filter_child_count_ratio.description: Count ratio threshold for filtering child categories.

filter_child_removed_ratio.description: Removed ratio threshold for filtering child categories.

stat_metric.description: Statistical metric to use for dependency calculation.

sort_by_chi.description: If true, sort features by chi-square value.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth in the category hierarchy.

max_parents.description: Maximum number of parents for a category.

use_fixed_lift.description: If true, use a fixed lift value.

filter_hierarchy.description: If true, filter based on the category hierarchy.

verbose_full_file.description: File to write full verbose output to.

generate_with_counts.description: If true, generate features with counts.

fg_category_depend.title: FG: Category Dependency
fg_category_depend.description: Discovers and creates features from categorical signals that show strong statistical dependency with the outcome, potentially stratified by age and gender.

fg_embedding_properties.description: Specific properties for the 'embedding' generator are not detailed in the provided code.

fg_embedding.title: FG: Embedding
fg_embedding.description: Applies a pre-trained embedding model to generate features.

fg_extract_tbl_properties.description: Specific properties for the 'extract_tbl' generator are not detailed in the provided code.

fg_extract_tbl.title: FG: Extract Table
fg_extract_tbl.description: Extracts values from a lookup table based on keys and join rules.

fg_diabetes_finder_properties.description: Specific properties for the 'diabetes_finder' generator are not detailed in the provided code.

fg_diabetes_finder.title: FG: Diabetes Finder
fg_diabetes_finder.description: A specialized generator to find and feature-ize diabetes-related information.

action.title: Model Component Action
action.description: A single step in the model processing pipeline.

oneOf.title: Repository Processor Action Set
oneOf.description: A set of repository processors to be applied to the data. These processors perform data cleaning, transformation, and virtual signal creation.

oneOf.title: Feature Processor Action Set
oneOf.description: A set of processors that are applied to the generated features.

oneOf.title: Post Processor Action Set
oneOf.description: A set of processors applied after the model prediction.

name.description: Name of the feature to clean.

missing_value.description: The value that represents a missing observation.

normalizeSd.description: If true, normalize by standard deviation.

resolution_only.description: If true, only apply resolution transformation.

fillMissing.description: If true, fill missing values with the mean.

max_samples.description: Maximum number of samples to use for learning normalization parameters.

use_linear_transform.description: If true, apply a linear transformation.

min_samples.description: Minimum number of samples required to compute the imputation value.

moment_type.description: The type of statistic to use for imputation (e.g., mean, median).

learn_moment_type.description: The type of statistic to learn from the data.

apply_moment_type.description: The type of statistic to apply for imputation.

max_samples.description: Maximum number of samples to use for learning imputation values.

round_to_existing_value.description: If true, round the imputed value to the nearest existing value.

leave_missing_for_small_stratas.description: If true, do not impute for small strata.

impute_strata_with_missing.description: If true, impute strata that have missing values.

method.description: The statistical method to use for feature selection.

minStat.description: The minimum statistic value for a feature to be selected.

nBins.description: Number of bins for discretization when using 'mi' or 'dcorr'.

binMethod.description: The method to use for binning.

takeSquare.description: If 1, use the square of the statistic.

pDistance.description: Power for the distance correlation ('dcorr') method.

max_samples.description: Maximum number of samples to use for calculation.

penalty.description: The penalty coefficient for the mRMR calculation.

penaltyMethod.description: The method to apply the penalty ('max' or 'mean').

initMaxLambda.description: Initial maximum lambda value for the LASSO path.

lambdaRatio.description: Ratio for decreasing lambda in the LASSO path.

lax_lasso_features.description: List of features to which LASSO is applied more leniently.

rate.description: Learning rate for the LASSO solver.

stop_at_err.description: Error threshold to stop the LASSO solver.

percentage.description: The percentage of a single value that defines a feature as degenerate.

selected_tags.description: An array of tags. Features with any of these tags will be selected.

removed_tags.description: An array of tags. Features with any of these tags will be removed.

predictor.description: The predictor to use for calculating feature importance.

minStat.description: Minimum importance score for a feature to be selected.

predictor.description: The predictor to use for iterative selection.

predictor_params_file.description: Path to a file with predictor parameters.

folds.description: Array of fold assignments for each sample.

rates.description: Comma-separated list of rates for feature removal/addition.

work_on_sets.description: If true, work on sets of features.

group_to_sigs.description: If true, group features by signal.

progress_file_path.description: Path to a file to save progress.

pca_top.description: Number of top principal components to keep.

pca_cutoff.description: Cumulative variance cutoff for selecting principal components.

subsample_count.description: Number of samples to use for PCA.

prefix.description: Prefix for the new one-hot encoded feature names.

add_other.description: If true, add an 'other' category for infrequent values.

max_values.description: Maximum number of unique values to encode. Others will be grouped into 'other'.

missing_value.description: Value to use for missing probabilities.

all_labels.description: If true, calculate probabilities for all labels.
